from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    consolidated_net_income_value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of consolidated net income")
    consolidated_net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of net income: 'dollars', 'thousands', or 'millions'")
    consolidated_net_income_sign: str | None = Field(description="Whether net income is positive 'profit' or negative 'loss'")
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of total assets")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of total assets: 'dollars', 'thousands', or 'millions'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="Period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt containing the financial figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
